verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              पञ्च तं नाभ्यवर्तन्त विपरीतेन कर्मणा। वेदो धर्मः क्षमा सत्यं श्रीश्च नारायणाश्रया॥१॥
स तेषामनुपस्थानात्सक्रोधो दानवेशवरः। वैष्णवं पदमन्विच्छन्ययौ नारायणान्तिकम्॥२॥
verses.english: Let apportionment of offertories recommence while brAhmaNa-s rekindle the ritual fire according to the canons of scriptures, and while sages hallow it… that done, let the gods attain gratification from doles, sacrificial oblations and offertories; sages from the self-study of Vedas; manes from beatification, as is their wont…
verses.bhavadeepa: कालनेमिवधः प्रोक्तश्चत्वारिंशेऽष्टसंयुते। इन्द्रादीनां निजस्थानस्थापनं विष्णुना कृतम्॥१॥ पञ्चेति। विपरीतेन असात्विकेन कर्मणा न अभ्यवर्तन्त नोपतस्थुः॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: स ददर्श सुपर्णस्थं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम्। दानवानां विनाशाय भ्रामयन्तं गदां शुभाम्॥३॥
verses.english: Although his arms are chopped off and his heads are cut off, that dAnava काल-नेमि did not flinch the least but still stood in the battle like the trunk of a tree shorn of all its branches…

verses.sanskrit: सजलाम्भोदसदृशं विद्युत्सदृशवाससम्। स्वारूढं स्वर्णपत्राढ्यं शिखिनं काश्यपं खगम्॥४॥
verses.english: You are the only destroyer of this काल-नेमि whom you have just slain in battle… save thee; there is none else capable of it…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा दैत्यविनाशाय रणे स्वस्थमवस्थितम्। दानवो विष्णुमक्षोभ्यं बभाषे क्षुब्धमानसः॥५॥
verses.english: May I ask you now to return the prosperous triad of worlds to high-souled indra since the thorns called demons are prised out in this war…?” so said brahma to viShNu.
verses.bhavadeepa: स्वारूढं शिखिनं चूडामन्तम्॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: अयं स रिपुरस्माकं पूर्वेषां दानवर्षिणाम्। अर्णवावासिनश्चैव मधोर्वै कैटभस्य च॥६॥
verses.english: Such a demon काल-नेमि whose sheen matches the gloss of deathly Time has been eliminated by you, for which I am highly pleased…

verses.sanskrit: अयं सविग्रहोऽस्माकमशाम्यः किल कथ्यते। येन नः संयुगेष्वाद्या बहवो दानवा हताः॥७॥
verses.bhavadeepa: दानवर्षिणामित्यार्षो दैर्घ्याभावः। दानैः वर्षणशीलानामिति वा॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: अयं स निर्घृणो युद्धेऽस्त्री बालनिरपत्रपः। येन दानवनारीणां सीमन्तोद्धरणं कृतम्॥८॥
verses.english: This one is our enemy, a perpetual enemy right from our forefathers, even an enemy of earliest known demons living underwater, namely मधु and कैटभ; This one is that challenger with whom, they say, a confrontation is unslakeable – अ-श्याम्य, such as he is he eliminated many of our demons inveigling them to warfield… This one is that merciless one in battles, diversely weaponed, shamelessly presumptuous like a boy, and who wiped off the vermilion powder from the parting of female demons’ combed hair– सीमन्त सिन्दूरम्…
verses.bhavadeepa: अशाम्यः शमयितुमशक्यः॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: अयं स विष्णुर्देवानां वैकुण्ठश्च दिवौकसाम्। अनन्तो भोगिनामप्सु स्वयम्भूश्च स्वयम्भुवः॥९॥
verses.english: This one is that विष्णु among all the sons of lady अदिति, who eventually became gods; this is the dweller of वैकुण्ठ as the other celestials like वसु-s, रुद्र-s, मरुत्-s et al hypothesize him; This is the one that has eternal serpent which carries world on its hood, namely अनन्त, or आदि-शेष, as his bed; this one is waters and this is the one who is afloat on seawater – a self-created creator of creator brahma…
verses.bhavadeepa: निर्घृणो निर्दयः अस्त्री अस्त्रमान् बालवन्निर्लज्जश्च सीमन्तस्य केशवेशस्य उद्धरणं मुण्डनमित्यर्थः॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: अयं स नाथो देवानामस्माकं विप्रिये स्थितः। अस्य क्रोधेन महता हिरण्यकशिपुर्हतः॥१०॥
verses.english: This one is that God Almighty of all gods and this one alone is the standing vitriol of ours; this one’s high fury caused the death of my father, demon हरण्य-कशिपु…
verses.bhavadeepa: देवानाम् अदितिपुत्राणां मध्ये विष्णुर्वामनः दिवौकसां वसुरुद्रादीनां वैकुण्ठः कल्पान्तेऽप्यकुण्ठितधामा अनन्तः शेषः स्वयम्भुवः ब्रह्मणोऽपि स्वयम्भुः धातुर्धातेत्यर्थः॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: अस्य छायां समासाद्य देवा मखमुखे स्थिताः। आज्यं महर्षिभिर्दत्तमश्नुवन्ति त्रिधा हुतम्॥११॥
verses.english: Either in your own houses, or in heaven, or on battlefields especially you gods should not think that you are invulnerable, for demons are knavish…

verses.sanskrit: अयं स निधने हेतुः सर्वेषां देवविद्विषाम्। यस्य तेजाःप्रविष्टानि कुलान्यस्माकमाहवे॥१२॥
verses.english: On addressing the gods that magnificent nArAyaNa, whose prowess is truth, went to the abode of brahma along with brahma…
verses.bhavadeepa: छायां पक्षे कोटिं त्रिधा अङ्गप्रधानप्रायश्चित्तभेदेन त्रिप्रकारं नित्यनैमित्तिककाम्यभेदेन वा गार्हपत्याद्युपाधिभेदेनेति प्राञ्चः॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: अयं स किल युद्धेषु सुरार्थे त्यक्तजीवितः। सवितुस्तेजसा तुल्यं चर्क्रं क्षिपति शत्रुषु॥१३॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the forty-eight chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the elimination of demon काल-नेमि in starwars

verses.sanskrit: अयं स कालो दैत्यानां कालभूते मयि स्थिते। अतिक्रान्तस्य कालस्य फलं प्राप्स्यति दुर्मतिः॥१४॥
verses.english: This one is that god of fatality unto demons, but now I am his fatality because I am standing up to his authority; if this invidious god oversteps his bounds he will reap the fruit of it…

verses.sanskrit: दिष्ट्येदानीं समक्षं मे विष्णुरेष समागतः। अद्य मद्बाणनिष्पिष्टो मामेव प्रणमिष्यति॥१५॥
verses.english: This one is that god विष्णु who by mere chance is available in my fore… now, will he truckle to me by my valour… else, will he get battered with my arrows… which one he prefers…
verses.bhavadeepa: अतिक्रान्तस्य कालस्य अतिक्रान्ते काले कृतस्य दैत्यवधस्य फलम् आत्मवधम्॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: यास्याम्यपचितिं दिष्ट्या पूर्वेषामद्य संयुगे। इमं नारायणं हत्वा दानवानां भयावहम्॥१६॥
verses.english: O, janamejaya this is the marvellous event about which you asked me to detail, occurred during the battling of demons spearheaded by तारक when they confronted viShNu…

verses.sanskrit: क्षिप्रमेव वधिष्यामि रणे नारायणाश्रितान्। जात्यन्तरगतोऽप्येष मृधे बाधति दानवान्॥१७॥
verses.english: This one is that interminable god previously renowned as a god with lotus-navel who eliminated two glorious demons मधु and कैटभ that went underwater, when whole universe became one sheet of water, just by placing them within his knee-joints…

verses.sanskrit: एषोऽनन्थः पुरा भूत्वा पद्मनाभ इति स्मृतः। जघानैकार्णवे घोरे तावुभौ मधुकैटभौ। विनिवेश्य स्वके ऊरौ निहतौ दानवेश्वरौ॥१८॥
verses.english: This one is that interminable god previously renowned as a god with lotus-navel who eliminated two glorious demons मधु and कैटभ that went underwater, when whole universe became one sheet of water, just by placing them within his knee-joints…
verses.bhavadeepa: जात्यन्तरं मत्स्यादिरूपम्॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: द्विधाभूतं वपुः कृत्वा सिंहार्धं नरसंस्थितम्। पितरं मे जघानैको हिरण्यकशिपुं पुरा॥१९॥
verses.english: This one is that god who on assuming half-lion and half-man physique singly killed my father हिरण्य-कशिपु in the days of yore…
verses.bhavadeepa: अनन्तः आकाशवत् व्यापको मूर्तिरहितोऽपि भूत्वा आविर्भूय। पद्मनाभत्वेन रूपेण तन्नाम्ना च ख्यात इत्यर्थः॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: शुभं गर्भमधत्तेममदितिर्देवतारणिः। यज्ञकाले बलेर्यो वै कृत्वा वामनरूपताम्। त्रीँल्लोकानाजहारैकः क्रममाणस्त्रिभिः क्रमैः॥२०॥
verses.english: This one is that god whom the auspicious lady अदिति once conceived, as if she is a celestial wood-stick wishing to produce fire, and delivered as a dwarf-boy, who at a time when emperor बलि is conducting a vedic ritual singly appropriated all the three worlds, taking just three strides…

verses.sanskrit: भूयस्त्विदानीं समरे सम्प्राप्ते तारकामये। मया सह समागम्य सह देवैर्विनङ्क्ष्यति॥२१॥
verses.english: Thus addressed by god brahma, shrIhari said to gods through their mouthpiece, namely indra, in these auspicious words…
verses.bhavadeepa: देवतानाम् अरणिरिव मातेत्यर्थः॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: स एवमुक्त्वा बहुधा क्षिपन्नारायणं रणे। वाग्भिरप्रतिरूपाभिर्युद्धमेवाभ्यरोचयत्॥२२॥
verses.english: “Limited is thy prideful strength, oh, दैत्य काल-नेमि, yet thou furiously speakest a specious rant… slain thou art, for thou goest over the threshold of tolerance with flaws in thy heart… thou art a wretch, methinks, thus fie on thy vaunting words… thine roaring is behovely amongst females than males… I behold thee, oh दैत्य, too willing to tread the path of thy predecessors… who liveth peacefully on rending a tideline that प्रजापति has ordained… I shall now eliminate thee that thwarted the activity of gods, restoring celestials to their respective positions…” so said विष्णु to काल-नेमि…
verses.bhavadeepa: विनङ्क्ष्यति अदर्शनं गमिष्यति तथा जन्मान्तरेऽप्यनेन सह वैरं भविष्यत्येवेत्यर्थः॥२१॥

verses.sanskrit: क्षिप्यमाणोऽसुरेन्द्रेण न चुकोप गदाधरः। क्षमाबलेन महता सस्मितं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥२३॥
verses.english: When nArAyaNa had said this to demon काल-नेमि in battle, that demon furiously laughed off, filled his hands with various weapons, raised those hundred hands that are gripping various weapons, and with his eyes doubly bloodshot, he smote shrIhari on chest at a place where that god is sporting a mark called श्रीवत्स…

verses.sanskrit: अल्पदर्पबलो दैत्यः स्थितः क्रोधादसद्वदन्। हतस्त्वमात्मनो दोषैः क्षमां योऽतीत्य भाषसे॥२४॥
verses.english: On seeing lonely विष्णु unaided by other gods, other dAnavA-s headed by मय end तारक rushed towards him with upraised weapons… although the highly powerful daityA-s assailed him armed with various weapons god shrIhari remained unshaken in the battle like a mountain when midgets rattle it…

verses.sanskrit: अधमस्त्वं मम मतो धिगेतत्तव वाग्बलम्। न तत्र पुरुषाः सन्ति यत्र गर्जन्ति योषितः॥२५॥
verses.bhavadeepa: दैत्यत्वम् अल्पदर्पबलोऽपि क्रोधादसद्वदन् स्थितः क्षमामतीत्य च भाषसे अतस्त्वमात्मनो दोषैरेव हतः॥२४॥

verses.sanskrit: अहं त्वां दैत्य पश्यामि पूर्वेषां मार्गगामिनम्। प्रजापतिकृतं सेतुं को भित्त्वा स्वस्तिमान्भवेत्॥२६॥
verses.english: When काल-नेमि grappled with the golden-winged गरुड to futility, he resorted to a mammoth mace, consolidating all his life-force he twirled it overhead and released that dreadful and blazing mace on that eagle, while viShNu watched all this astonishing at the impudence of that demon…
verses.bhavadeepa: न तत्रेति। योषितः पुरस्तात् गर्जनं न मरणावहं तत्र पुरुषान्तराभावात्। अत्र रणे तु तत्सत्त्वात्तव मृत्युरेवास्तीति भावः॥२५॥

verses.sanskrit: अद्य त्वां नाशयिष्यामि देवव्यापारकारकम्। स्वेषु स्वेषु च स्थानेषु स्थापयिष्यामि देवताः॥२७॥
verses.english: “Limited is thy prideful strength, oh, दैत्य काल-नेमि, yet thou furiously speakest a specious rant… slain thou art, for thou goest over the threshold of tolerance with flaws in thy heart… thou art a wretch, methinks, thus fie on thy vaunting words… thine roaring is behovely amongst females than males… I behold thee, oh दैत्य, too willing to tread the path of thy predecessors… who liveth peacefully on rending a tideline that प्रजापति has ordained… I shall now eliminate thee that thwarted the activity of gods, restoring celestials to their respective positions…” so said विष्णु to काल-नेमि…
verses.bhavadeepa: तदेवाह- अहमिति। सेतुं धर्ममर्यादाम्। स्वस्तिमान् कुशली॥२६॥

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवं ब्रुवति तद्वाक्यं मृधे श्रीवत्सधारिणि। जहास दानवः क्रोधाद्धस्तांश्चक्रे च सायुधान्॥२८॥
verses.english: When that club fell on the head of that king of birds, सुपर्ण, that eagle crash-landed and hopped on earth with a wounded body. Beholding wounded सुपर्ण, viShNu felt that his own body is scathed, then that dweller of वैकुण्ठ took up his discus with eyes reddened in anger…
verses.bhavadeepa: व्यापारः स्वास्थ्यप्रच्युतिः॥२७॥

verses.sanskrit: स बाहुशतमुद्यम्य सर्वास्त्रग्रहणं रणे। क्रोधाद्द्विगुणरक्ताक्षो विष्णुं वक्षस्यताडयत्॥२९॥
दानवाश्चापि समरे मयतारपुरोगमाः। उद्यतायुधनिस्त्रिंशादृष्ट्वा विष्णुमथाद्रवन्॥३०॥
verses.english: Then that lord viShNu grew highly impetuous along with सुपर्ण who by now is redeemed and carrying viShNu. viShNu’s arms multiplied covering and filling up all the ten quarters, the ethereal region and the earth, as his physique increased, and he seemed to tread all the worlds again as he has done in dwarf-boy incarnation…

verses.sanskrit: स ताड्यमानोऽतिबलैर्दैत्यैः सर्वायुधोद्यतैः। न चचाल हरिर्युद्धेऽकम्प्यमान इवाचलः॥३१॥
verses.english: The sages along with the gandharvA-s began to chant the glories of मधुसुदन who had then assumed a huge proportion in the sky for the victory of the gods…

verses.sanskrit: संसक्तश्च सुपर्णेन कालनेमी महासुरः। सर्वप्राणेन महतीं गदामुद्यम्य बाहुभिः॥३२॥
verses.english: His crown scribing on the sky like a scribe-awl, his cloths scraping clouded sky, his feet covering the earth, his arms shrouding the sky shrIhari stood there ringing his सुदर्शन disc on the forefinger of right hand…

verses.sanskrit: मुमोच ज्वलितां घोरां संरब्धो गरुडोपरि। कर्मणा तेन दैत्यस्य विष्णुर्विस्मयमागतः॥३३॥
verses.english: Whirling that disc which in effulgence is like sun, with thousand-sprockets, an enemy-neutraliser, deadly like inferno, yet magnificent for a look…
verses.bhavadeepa: सर्वप्राणेन सर्वबलेन॥३२॥

verses.sanskrit: यदा तस्य सुपर्णस्य पतिता मूर्ध्नि सा गदा। तदागमत्पदा भूमिं पक्षी व्यथितविग्रहः॥३४॥
verses.english: Entirely golden from hub to periphery, diamonded at hub, calamitous, daubed with fat, marrow, calcific materials of bones and blood of demons when they are periodically sliced…

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्णं व्यथितं दृष्ट्वा क्षतं च वपुरात्मनः। क्रोधात्संरक्तनयनो वैकुण्ठश्चक्रमाददे॥३५॥
verses.english: Second to none in impaction, razor-sharp from edge to hub, propulsive circularly like a garland of fire when one firebrand, flaming-ball is swung circularly –triggerer-target-back to triggerer propulsion – will be like a garland without the evidence of string, and which propels at the wish of its triggerer…

verses.sanskrit: व्यवर्धत च वेगेन सुपर्णेन समं प्रभुः। भुजाश्चास्य व्यवर्धन्त व्याप्नुवन्तो दिशो दश॥३६॥
verses.english: That disc is a personal creation of brahma, a terror to the enemies, infallible since swaddled in the wrath of sages, always haughty on the battlefield…
verses.bhavadeepa: आत्मनो वपुः देहान्तरं गरुडरूपम्॥३५॥

verses.sanskrit: स दिशः प्रदिशश्चैव खं च गां चैव पूरयन्। ववृधे स पुनर्लोकान्क्रान्तुकाम इवौजसा॥३७॥
verses.english: As before let moon seasonally unite with stars, let the sun united with equinoctial points cause years with four faces, where each face is a season…
verses.bhavadeepa: व्यवर्धतेति॥३६॥

verses.sanskrit: तं जयाय सुरेन्द्राणां वर्धमानं नभस्तले। ऋषयः सह गन्धर्वैस्तुष्टुवुर्मधुसूदनम्॥३८॥
verses.english: Such a disc of incomparable operations, equalling the blaze of sun has been upraised by shrIhari, spinning on his right forefinger, in all his fury in that combat…

verses.sanskrit: स द्यां किरीटेन लिखन्साभ्रमम्बरमबरैः। पद्भ्यामाक्रम्य वसुधां दिशः प्रच्छाद्य बाहुभिः॥३९॥
verses.english: His crown scribing on the sky like a scribe-awl, his cloths scraping clouded sky, his feet covering the earth, his arms shrouding the sky shrIhari stood there ringing his सुदर्शन disc on the forefinger of right hand…

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यस्य रश्मितुल्याभं सहस्रारमरीक्षयम्। दीप्ताग्निसदृशं घोरं दर्शनीयं सुदर्शनम्॥४०॥
verses.english: Further, shrIhari with that disc सुदर्शन rived the hundred macabre heads of that demon काल-नेमि that have stentorian laughs like the blaring trebuchets, or catapults that launch glaring fireballs – गोलक उत्क्शेपण यन्त्रा-स्; तेषाम् महा शब्दः…
verses.bhavadeepa: अम्बरैः वस्त्रैः॥३९॥

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णनेमिपर्यन्तं वज्रनाभं भयावहम्। मेदोमज्जास्थिरुधिरैर्दिग्धं दानवसम्भवैः॥४१॥
verses.english: Although his arms are chopped off and his heads are cut off, that dAnava काल-नेमि did not flinch the least but still stood in the battle like the trunk of a tree shorn of all its branches…

verses.sanskrit: अद्वितीयं प्रहारेशु क्षुरपर्यन्तमण्डलम्। स्रग्दाममालविततं कामगं कामरूपिणम्॥४२॥
verses.english: Spreading both of his sweeping wings, assuming the speed of a tempest, garuDa with a single bump of his chest knocked काल-नेमि down… felling that faceless, armless truck of that demon so far vaulting on the sky onto earth in one fell swoop…
verses.bhavadeepa: सुवर्णनेमिपर्यन्तं सुवर्णमयो नेमेश्चक्रधारायाः पर्यन्तः प्रान्तदेशो यस्य तत् वज्रनाभं दृढमध्यम्॥४१॥

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं स्वयम्भुवा सृष्टं भयदं सर्वविद्विषाम्। महर्षिरोषैराविष्टं नित्यमाहवदर्पितम्॥४३॥
verses.english: When that daitya काल-नेमि is thus eliminated all the gods with sages began to praise nArAyaNa saying “Good Lord! Good heavens!”
verses.bhavadeepa: स्रग्दाममालाविततं स्रग्रूपाणां दाम्नां माला परम्परा तद्वत् विततम् अलातचक्रवदतिवेगात् प्रयोक्तुर्हस्तमारभ्य लक्ष्यप्रदेशपर्यन्तम् अविच्छिन्नधारं विभातीत्यर्थः। कामरूपिणमिति। सकृत्प्रयुक्तमपि प्रयोक्तुरिच्छया स्थूलसूक्ष्मऋजुतिर्यगादिरूपाणि दधानम्। पुंस्त्वं तु सर्वत्र तदधिष्ठातृरुद्राभिप्रायेण॥४२॥

verses.sanskrit: क्षेपणाद्यस्य मुह्यन्ति लोकाः सस्थाणुजङ्गमाः। क्रव्यादानि च भूतानि तृप्तिं यान्ति महाहवे॥४४॥
verses.english: By activating which in a given war all the worlds with sessile and mobile beings will become insensate, whereby carnivores can satisfyingly make a feast-day…

verses.sanskrit: तमप्रतिमकर्माणं समानं सूर्यवर्चसा। चक्रमुद्यम्य समरे क्रोधदीप्तो गदाधरः॥४५॥
verses.english: Offering an affront to all gods, all worlds together with their mobile and sessile creatures this dAnava not only set sages at naught but used to rage and rail against me…

verses.sanskrit: सम्मुष्णन्दानवं तेजः समरे स्वेन तेजसा। चिच्छेद बाहुं चक्रेण श्रीधरः कालनेमिनः॥४६॥
तच्च वक्त्रशतं घोरं साग्निचूर्णाट्टहासिनम्। तस्य दैत्यस्य चक्रेण प्रममाथ बलाद्धरिः॥४७॥
स छिन्नबाहुर्विशिरा न प्राकम्पत दानवः। कबन्धोऽवस्थितः सङ्ख्ये विशाख इव पादपः॥४८॥
verses.english: When all the demons are wiped out, nArAyaNa stood there concluding that his mission and a deed to indra’s liking is accomplished… when that dreadful war with demon तारक is subdued and completed brahma came there post haste along with sages, gandharvA-s and scores of apsara-s ad said this to viShNu worshipfully…
verses.bhavadeepa: साग्निचूर्णानि आग्नेयौषधबलेन गोलकोत्क्षेपणयन्त्राणि तेषामिव अट्टहासो महाशब्दः तद्युक्तं साग्निचूर्णाट्टहासिनं वक्रशतं पुंस्त्वमार्षम्॥४७॥

verses.sanskrit: तं वितत्य महापक्षौ वायोः कृत्वा समं जवम्। उरसा पातयामास गरुडः कालनेमिनम्॥४९॥
स तस्य देहो विमुखो विशाखः खात्परिभ्रमन्। निपपात दिवं त्यक्त्वा शोभयन्धरणीतलम्॥५०॥
verses.english: “Oh, god, you have achieved a great mission of gods and a thorn in gods’ side is removed… indeed, we all are heartily pleased with the destruction of all the demons…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्निपतिते दैत्ये देवाः सर्षिगणास्तदा। साधु साध्विति वैकुण्ठं समेताः प्रत्यपूजयन्॥५१॥
verses.english: You are the only destroyer of this काल-नेमि whom you have just slain in battle… save thee; there is none else capable of it…

verses.sanskrit: अपरे ये तु दैत्या वै युद्धे दुष्टपराक्रमाः। ते सर्वे बाहुभिर्व्याप्ता न शेकुश्चलितुं रणे॥५२॥
verses.bhavadeepa: बाहुभिः दिशः प्रच्छाद्य बाहुभिरिति प्रागुक्तलक्षणैः हरेरिति शेषः। व्याप्ताः आक्रान्ताः॥५१॥

verses.sanskrit: कांश्चित्केशेषु जग्राह कांश्चित्कण्ठेऽभ्यपीडयत्। पाटयत्कस्यचिद्वक्त्रं मध्ये कांश्चिदथाग्रहीत्॥५३॥
verses.english: Such a demon काल-नेमि whose sheen matches the gloss of deathly Time has been eliminated by you, for which I am highly pleased…

verses.sanskrit: ते गदाचक्रनिर्दग्धा गतसत्त्वा गतासवः। गगनाद्भ्रष्टसर्वाङ्गा निपेतुर्धरणीतले॥५४॥
verses.english: Mayst thou fare well; may I invite you to the most excellent celestial region of mine, ब्रम-लोक, where the brahma-sages, the members of my aseembly, are waiting for thee…

verses.sanskrit: तेषु सर्वेषु दैत्येषु हतेषु पुरुषोत्तमः। तस्थौ शक्रप्रियं कृत्वा कृतकर्मा गदाधरः॥५५॥
verses.english: There, oh, अच्युत, oh, foremost of speakers, I along with other sages shall worship you with heavenly hymns…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्विमर्दे निर्वृत्ते सङ्ग्रामे तारकामये। तं देशमाजगामाशु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः॥५६॥
verses.english: “Poor me, oh god, how canst I fulfil thy will, for thou thyself art the foremost conferrer of favours, either on gods or on demons?

verses.sanskrit: सर्वैर्ब्रह्मर्षिभिः सार्धं गन्धर्वैः साप्सरोगणैः। देवदेवो हरिं देवं पूजयन्वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥५७॥
verses.english: Mayst thou fare well; may I invite you to the most excellent celestial region of mine, ब्रम-लोक, where the brahma-sages, the members of my aseembly, are waiting for thee…
verses.bhavadeepa: विमर्दे दैत्यानां विनाशे निवृत्ते जाते सति॥५६॥

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मोवाच।
              कृतं देव महत्कर्म सुराणां शल्यमुद्धृतम्। वधेनानेन दैत्यानां वयं हि परितोषिताः॥५८॥
verses.english: They strike people as soon as they find a weak point; impermanent and slippery is their modus vivendi or operandi… hence, you should be vigilant for you gods are all gentle, simple and idyllic-minded…

verses.sanskrit: योऽयं हतस्त्वया विष्णो कालनेमी महासुरः। त्वमेकोऽस्य मृधे हन्ता नान्यः कश्चन विद्यते॥५९॥
verses.english: “Listen attentively, all of you gods assembled here headed by indra, we have slain all valorous dAnavA-s that are superior even to the king of gods himself, and that are operating under the steersmanship of demon kAla-nemi in this battle…

verses.sanskrit: एष देवान्परिभवँल्लोकांश्च सचराचरान्। ऋषीणां कदनं कृत्वा मामपि प्रतिगर्जति॥६०॥
verses.english: But, somehow two demons made their getaway in this terrible encounter, one is the son of विरोचन, namely emperor-demon बलि, and the other is the capacious planetomorphic राहु, the eclipser… hence, you gods have to remain vigilant about them…

verses.sanskrit: तदनेन तवोग्रेण परितुष्टोऽस्मि कर्मणा। यदयं कालतुल्याभः कालनेमी निपातितः॥६१॥
verses.english: Whenever you experience a dreadful fear from the dAnavA-s, I will immediately come to your rescue… I promise…” so said viShNu to all gods.

verses.sanskrit: तदागच्छस्व भद्रं ते गच्छाम दिवमुत्तमम्। ब्रह्मर्षयस्त्वां तत्रस्थाः प्रतीक्षन्ते सदोगताः॥६२॥
verses.english: As before let moon seasonally unite with stars, let the sun united with equinoctial points cause years with four faces, where each face is a season…

verses.sanskrit: अहं महर्षयश्चैव तत्र त्वां वदतां वर। विधिवच्चार्चयिष्यामो गीर्भिर्दिव्याभिरच्युत॥६३॥
किं चाहं तव दास्यामि वरं वरभृतां वर। सुरेष्वपि सदैत्येषु वराणां वरदो भवान्॥६४॥
verses.english: “Poor me, oh god, how canst I fulfil thy will, for thou thyself art the foremost conferrer of favours, either on gods or on demons?

verses.sanskrit: निर्यातयैतत्त्रैलोक्यं स्फीतं निहतकण्टकम्। अस्मिन्नेव मृधे विष्णो शक्राय सुमहात्मने॥६५॥
verses.english: Let the wind blow in its own course, let domestic-ritual-fire be enkindled in its three-fold forms, and let the three social orders, by their natural qualities, bring about the gratification to the world…

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तो भगवता ब्रह्मणा हरिरव्ययः। देवाञ्छक्रमुखान्सर्वानुवाच शुभया गिरा॥६६॥
verses.english: Let sacrifices be undertaken by the brAhmaNa-s who are worthy of performing initiatory rites and let proper gifts be distributed as befitting in all sacrifices…
verses.bhavadeepa: निर्यातय प्रयच्छ। मृधे त्वयैव निहतकण्टकम्॥६५॥

verses.sanskrit:
विष्णुरुवाच।
              श्रूयतां त्रिदशाः सर्वे यावन्तोऽत्र समागताः। श्रवणावहितैर्देहैः पुरस्कृत्य पुरन्दरम्॥६७॥
verses.english: Let the sun afford gratification to all the eyes, let moon afford delight to all the essential fluids, let air delight the vital breaths to all beings, because sun, moon, and air are - नेत्र, रस, प्राण स्वरूपा-s – epitomes of sight, pith and lifeforce; as such, let these three sun, moon, and air be slacked in first instance with auspicious and humble oblations whereby individual beings get slacked in give-and-take syndrome…

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्नः समरे सर्वे कालनेमिमुखा हताः। दानवा विक्रमोपेताः शक्रादपि महत्तराः॥६८॥
verses.english: Let all the declivitous rivers, the good mothers of the triadic world, spouting from great mountains glide to sea as usual and non-stop…
verses.bhavadeepa: देहैर्देहेन्द्रियादिभिः श्रवणविहितैर्मद्वाक्यश्रवणे सादरैः करणैरिन्द्रं पुरस्कृत्य मद्वाक्यं श्रूयतामित्यन्वयः॥६७॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्महति सङ्क्रन्दे द्वावेव तु विनिस्सृतौ। वैरोचनश्च दैत्येन्द्रः स्वर्भानुश्च महाग्रहः॥६९॥
verses.english: Let gods cast off all fear of dAnavA-s and let them enjoy peace. May you fare well… ye gods, I repair to the eternal abode of brahma…
verses.bhavadeepa: अस्मिन्नः अस्माभिः॥६८॥

verses.sanskrit: तदिष्टां भजतां शक्रोदिशं वरुण एव च। याम्यां यमः पालयतामुत्तरां च धनाधिपः॥७०॥
verses.english: Either in your own houses, or in heaven, or on battlefields especially you gods should not think that you are invulnerable, for demons are knavish…
verses.bhavadeepa: वैरोचनिर्बलिः स्वर्भानुः राहुः॥६९॥

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षैः सह यथायोगं काले चरतु चन्द्रमाः। अब्दं चतुर्मुखं सूर्यो भजतामयनैः सह॥७१॥
verses.english: They strike people as soon as they find a weak point; impermanent and slippery is their modus vivendi or operandi… hence, you should be vigilant for you gods are all gentle, simple and idyllic-minded…

verses.sanskrit: आज्यभागाः प्रवर्तन्तां सदस्यैरभिपूजिताः। हूयन्तामग्नयो विप्रैर्वेददृष्टेन कर्मणा॥७२॥
verses.english: O gods, I will always traumatize that evil-minded entity that nurtures an ill-will towards you…

verses.sanskrit: दानैश्च बलिहोमेन स्वाध्यायेन महर्षयः। श्राद्धेन पितरश्चैव तृप्तिं यान्तु यथा पुरा॥७३॥
verses.english: Whenever you experience a dreadful fear from the dAnavA-s, I will immediately come to your rescue… I promise…” so said viShNu to all gods.

verses.sanskrit: वायुश्चरतु मार्गस्थस्त्रिधा दीप्यतु पावकः। त्रयो वर्णाश्च लोकांस्त्रीन्वर्धयन्त्वात्मजैर्गुणैः॥७४॥
verses.english: Let the wind blow in its own course, let domestic-ritual-fire be enkindled in its three-fold forms, and let the three social orders, by their natural qualities, bring about the gratification to the world…

verses.sanskrit: क्रतवः सम्प्रवर्तन्तां दीक्षणीयैर्द्विजातिभिः। दक्षिणाश्चोपवर्तन्तां यथार्हं सर्वसत्रिणाम्॥७५॥
verses.english: Let sacrifices be undertaken by the brAhmaNa-s who are worthy of performing initiatory rites and let proper gifts be distributed as befitting in all sacrifices…
verses.bhavadeepa: त्रिधा गार्हपत्यदक्षिणाग्न्याहवनीयरूपेण आत्मजैः स्वाभाविकगुणधर्मैः शमो दमस्तपः शौचमित्यादिना गीतासूपदिष्टैः॥७४॥

verses.sanskrit: गाश्च सूर्यो रसान्सोमो वायुः प्राणांश्च प्राणिषु। तर्पयन्तः प्रवर्तन्तां शिवैः सौम्यैश्च कर्मभिः॥७६॥
verses.english: Let the sun afford gratification to all the eyes, let moon afford delight to all the essential fluids, let air delight the vital breaths to all beings, because sun, moon, and air are - नेत्र, रस, प्राण स्वरूपा-s – epitomes of sight, pith and lifeforce; as such, let these three sun, moon, and air be slacked in first instance with auspicious and humble oblations whereby individual beings get slacked in give-and-take syndrome…

verses.sanskrit: यथावदानुपूर्व्येण महेन्द्रसलिलोद्भवाः। त्रैलोक्यमातरः सर्वाः सागरं यान्तु निम्नगाः॥७७॥
दैत्येभ्यस्त्यज्यतां भीश्च शान्तिं व्रजत देवताः। स्वस्ति वोऽस्तु गमिष्यामि ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम्॥७८॥
स्वगृहे सर्वलोके वा सङ्ग्रामे वा विशेषतः। विश्रम्भो वो न मन्तव्यो नित्यं क्षुद्रा हि दानवाः॥७९॥
छिद्रेषु प्रहरन्त्येते न चैषां संस्थितिर्ध्रुवा। सौम्यानामृजुभावानां भवतां चार्जवे मतिः॥८०॥
verses.bhavadeepa: विश्रम्भः विश्वासः वः युष्माभिः क्षुद्राः वञ्चकाः॥७९॥

verses.sanskrit: अहं तु दुष्टभावानां युष्मासु सुदुरात्मनाम्। असम्यग्वर्तमानानां मोहं दास्यामि देवताः॥८१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: संस्थितिः मर्यादा॥८०॥

verses.sanskrit: यदा च सुदुराधर्षं दानवेभ्यो भयं भवेत्। तदा समुपगम्याशु विधास्ये वस्ततोऽभयम्॥८२॥
verses.bhavadeepa: मोहं विषयबुद्धिं यया धर्ममप्यधर्म इति त्यक्ष्यन्ति अधर्ममपि धर्म इति मत्वाऽनुष्ठास्यन्ति॥८१॥

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवमुक्त्वा सुरगणान्विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः। जगाम ब्रह्मणा सार्धं ब्रह्मलोकं महायशाः॥८३॥
verses.bhavadeepa: अभयमिति छेदः॥८२॥

verses.sanskrit: एतदाश्चर्यमभवत्सङ्ग्रामे तारकामये। दानवानां च विष्णोश्च यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥८४॥
